item: Records with corrupt time stamps among good ones (off the time grid and out of order) are left out; each is in the audit trail

Records stamped before the first year or in the future, or after the clock jumped back by more than a day within a file, are left out as a reset clock (off: kept at the time they carry; records with no time are always left out)
Every time stamp is moved to the base zone (the time zone in Settings)
The water a Solinst Gold or Junior adds for the altitude it was programmed with is taken off again
Barometric readings are interpolated linearly across gaps up to the hours under Settings, Advanced (off: only water readings at a barometric reading's time are compensated)
Where neither chosen barologger has a reading, another one fills in (shifted onto the primary's level, flagged)
Water levels are corrected to the tape checks between visits
Flags decided not a problem (Needs you) are left out of the exported flag columns; flags.csv keeps them, marked accepted
Readings close to installation, a download or a field visit, with too little water above the sensor, or well below the air pressure are flagged
